history.new: The burn-time fast-forward of the fuse magma (Theorem 4) is exact and takes O(L) time for every t - about three orders of magnitude faster than direct simulation at t = 10^5 (L = 1024; 4,021x in the first run, 1,363x on the Skeptic's re-run), with t = 10^9 in about a millisecond; because the O(L) method is a Python loop it loses to simulation for t below about 20-70.
history.old: The burn-time fast-forward of the fuse magma (Theorem 4) is exact and takes O(L) time for every t - 1.4-5.3x faster than direct simulation at t = 100 (L = 256-4096) and about 4000x at t = 10^5 (L = 1024); t = 10^9 in about 0.6 ms (L = 1024).
